title: Tech Saturn Tsuushin: Winter 1995: Taikenban & Demo-ban ga Tenkomori!
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ サターン通信 体験版＆デモ版がてんこもり！
overview:
The CD-ROM packaged with the Winter 1995 issue (Vol. 3) of ASCII's TECH Saturn Tsuushin magazine, packed with trial versions and demos of Saturn games.

Playable demos include Theme Park, Robo Pit, QuoVadis, Valora Valley Golf, Thunder Storm & Road Blaster and America Oudan Ultra Quiz. The disc also previews titles such as Death Mask, In the Hunt, Gunbird, X-Men: Children of the Atom, Galaxy Fight, Magical Drop and Shin Megami Tensei: Devil Summoner.
